■Degradation pathways of LIBs / • Multiple degradation mechanisms in LIBs: SEI growth, Li plating, microcracks… / • Degradation pathway-dependent SOH evolution: linear or nonlinear trajectories / • Multiple degradation pathways are convoluted within voltage signals, increasing the / difficulty of non-destructive diagnosis. / Microcrack Anode Cathode / Crosstalk / Li plating Si cracking / SEI growth / 2 Research seminar @ BML
